to: red names the task that broke a file, never the one repairing it

A second task id means the open task whose task-named commit, reachable from an active unmerged sibling branch, touches the failing file; the row labels it as repairing and carries the branch source. The historical id remains labeled as broke. The scan is opt-in with --repairs so the default answer and cost remain unchanged. An uncommitted sibling edit alone is not attributed because no task-to-file evidence exists, and a closed task is not described as repairing.
